name: Cave Cals+ Monthly
reviewNote: Cave Cals+ unlocks premium photo meal scanning, voice logging, and recipe link import. Manual tracking, barcode scanning, food search, saved meals, history, calorie goals, and widgets remain free. No app account sign-in is required. The monthly plan offers a 3-day free trial for eligible users; the yearly plan offers a 7-day free trial for eligible users. Open Settings and tap Explore Cave Cals+. Restore purchases appears below the offer; Manage subscription appears only for active members.

name: Cave Cals+ Monthly - Discount
reviewNote: Same Cave Cals+ subscription as the regular Yearly and Monthly plans, at a discount price for people with a trainer or creator code. These plans appear only after a discount code is applied. To see them: finish setup, then on "Where did you hear about Cave Cals?" choose Social media, enter code APPLEREVIEW, tap Apply, then Continue; the Cave Cals+ offer shows these plans. Or tap "Have a code?" at the bottom of any Cave Cals+ screen (Settings > Explore Cave Cals+). Cave Cals+ unlocks premium photo meal scanning, voice logging, and recipe import; manual tracking, barcode scanning, food search, saved meals, history, and calorie goals remain free. No account sign-in is required. The monthly plan offers a 3-day free trial and the yearly plan a 7-day free trial for eligible users.
